column3: Look at their clothes.\nThese are villagers.{end_wait}
I used to train\nuntil my head hurt.{end_wait}
Maybe it's easy for you.\nIt isn't for me.{end_wait}
Maybe some power\nacts on its own.{end_wait}
Like a sudden burst\nof strength in battle.{page_break}We can't summon it.\nNot yet.{end_wait}
Could we use this power\nat will, {actor_name:1}?{end_now}
We'll leave it to you,\n{actor_name:1}. Help them.{end_wait}
Then they'll stay trees\nuntil they die?{end_now}
How do we help Tret\nand lift the curse?{end_wait}
Promise you'll do\nall you can for Kolima.{end_wait}
But how do we save\nTret and Kolima?{end_wait}
We keep looking.\nThere must be a way.{end_wait}
I turned them into trees?\nThose people...\nWhat have I done?{end_wait}
Tret's too weak\nto lift the curse.{end_wait}
Then we heal him.{page_break}We can't abandon\nthose people.{end_wait}
Their lives depend\non what we do next.{end_wait}
Hrooom...\nThe pain is fading.\nI can think again.{end_wait}
Forgive me, Laurel.\nI let my anger\nconsume the forest.{end_wait}
You came back for me?\nAfter what I did?{end_now}
Tret has his strength.\nHe can help them.{end_wait}
Ask him to undo\nwhat he did.{end_wait}
Tret, the villagers\nare still suffering.\nCan you free them?{end_wait}
It came with the stones\nthat fell from the sky.{end_wait}
I don't want to believe\nit, either.{end_wait}

I was angry.
I wanted them to feel
what I had lost.{page_break}But I never meant
for this to happen.{end_wait}
The stones fell\nwhile I was grieving.\nI welcomed their power.{end_wait}
They gave your anger\nstrength. But the choice\nwas still yours.{end_wait}
Yes. I must answer\nfor what I have done.{end_wait}
Only the elder trees\nwere touched by them.{end_wait}
You fought beasts\non your journey here.{end_wait}
They were living things.{page_break}The stones changed them.\nWe don't know how.{end_wait}
Laurel, did the stones\nchange you too?{end_wait}
The stones changed me,\nbut they did not\ncommand my heart.{end_wait}
The animals have changed.{page_break}And south of the river...{end_wait}
That land is dangerous.{page_break}If you go, be careful.{end_wait}
Then stay here.\nThere's no shame in it.{end_wait}
If you came for Tret,\nyou may be too late.{end_wait}
His life is fading.{page_break}When he dies,\nthis forest will follow.{page_break}Leave while you can.{end_wait}
